title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
三天后...日落黄昏。看着郁郁葱葱，排列整齐的牧草，林枫露出了满意的微笑。再过一两天的样子，这些牧草，便能收割了。杰尼龟正奋力的在种好的地上面喷水。等到所有牧草和种植物都浇上一遍后，林枫喊了一声，“停。”杰尼龟顿时屁颠屁颠的跑了过来，后面的龟壳一顿一顿的，有些滑稽。林枫也适时的拿出了它喜欢的能量方块。【精灵：杰尼龟】【性别：雌】【特性：激流】【资质：蓝色】【实力：9级】【技能：撞击，摇尾巴，水枪，缩入壳中】【亲密度：60（它对你感官很好）】【愉悦值：60（心情很好）】三天的时间，林枫并没有给杰尼龟吃过任何的神奇糖果，但它的等级也维持在9级。这让林枫对【探查之眼】的等级探查制度，也有所了解。在没有到达一个阶段的上限时，会慢慢趋于一个巅峰。藤藤蛇也是如此。林枫又给藤藤蛇吃了两枚神奇糖果，在稳步消化后，它的实力位于17—19级，自身能量强度也有所上升，只是...仍旧没有进化。看样子，在进化这方面，似乎现实中不按他所想象的16级进化，而是有着其它的影响因素。“藤藤。”待杰尼龟浇灌完水后，藤藤蛇便开始用自己的青草场地帮助所有种植物加快成长。在这样两只宝可梦的帮助下。仅仅三天的时间。第一批种下去的蔬菜就已经快要成熟了。比如辣番果，现在已经长成了一米多高，上面挂的果子数量之多，让他都有些诧异。密密麻麻的挂着几十颗果子，而且还有开花的迹象。他一共种了三十株辣番果，可按这个趋向来看，每一株都能给他带来几十乃至上百斤的收获。而且像茄子，豆角那些，长的也格外喜人。相信再过两天，便能有大收获了。林枫有些憧憬，用系统给的肥料，再加上两只宝可梦的“悉心”

照顾，用这样的蔬菜，做出来的食物，料理效果，会不会再次上升？“好了，杰尼龟，你的第一阶段任务已经完成了，明天开始，就可以不用帮我浇水了。”正高兴吃着能量方块的杰尼龟动作一顿，接着有种打工人被辞退，天塌了的感觉出现在心中。什么？！杰尼龟不可置信的看向林枫，一双眼睛中，顿时被泪雾布满。自第一天后，它已经体会到了在林枫这里“工作”的好处。不论是技能的熟练程度，还是体内的能量，都在飞速的上升...现在的它，只想每天都来干活....“呃...只是第一阶段的任务结束了，下来是第二阶段...放心，这几天的能量方块不会断了你的。”林枫敲了一下它的头，然后拿出一枚神奇糖果，“来，吃了它。”这神奇糖果的作用，他在这几天也摸清楚了，就是单纯的提升能量强度，所以，根据宝可梦体内能量自生长的效率来看，三天一服是最好的。当然，天赋越好的宝可梦，可以缩短这个时间。只不过...这糖果，等宝可梦到了精英期后，效果估计就没那么大了。因为精英期后，能量强度已经到了它能提升的极致。“杰尼...”一口吞下神奇糖果，杰尼龟心中的大石落下，剧烈的情绪变化，以至于让它都没有感受到体内的能量变化....“好了，你今天可以回去了，明天再来吧。”心中存着事情，林枫马上就对杰尼龟下达了驱客令。“杰尼....”得到没有被“开除”的命令，杰尼龟拿着能量方块，欢天喜地的向着外面走去。而林枫则是在原地待了一会，等藤藤蛇用青草场地将所有的种植物都施加“生长”buff后，带着它来到了培育屋。扑通...一个飘逸的水花打起，鱼缸中的丑丑鱼一见到林枫，便不由自主的游动了起来。很显然。只要见到林枫，丑丑鱼的情绪就会莫名的高起来。因为这点。林枫属实是在它的身上获得了不少的神奇糖果和金坷拉。当然，也有可能是最近的丑丑鱼发现自己的变化了。因为它现在常常会面对鱼缸的玻璃，原本呆滞的鱼目，也会显得有些灵动，好似在借用玻璃观察自己。它体表的那些不规整的地方，在保养能量方块的作用下，确实平整光滑了起来。

Three days later...sunset and dusk.Looking at the lush and neatly arranged pasture, Lin Feng showed a satisfied smile.In a day or two, these pastures will be ready for harvest.Squirtle is struggling to spray water on the planted ground.After all the pastures and plants were watered, Lin Feng shouted, "Stop." Squirtle suddenly ran over, and the turtle shell behind him beat up, which was a bit funny.Lin Feng also took out his favorite energy cube at the right time.[Elf: Squirtle] [Gender: Female] [Characteristics: Riptide] [Qualification: Blue] [Strength: Level 9] [Skills: Crash, tail wagging, water gun, shrink into shell] [Intimacy: 60 (it has good senses for you)] [Pleasure value: 60 (good mood)] In three days, Lin Feng did not give Squirtle any magical candies, but its level was maintained at level 9.This gave Lin Feng some understanding of the level detection system of the [Detection Eye].When the upper limit of a stage is not reached, it will slowly reach a peak.The same goes for the vine snake.Lin Feng gave the Vine Snake two more magical candies. After digesting them steadily, its strength was at level 17-19, and its own energy intensity had also increased, but... it still hadn't evolved.It seems that in terms of evolution, it seems that in reality, it does not evolve according to the 16th level as he imagined, but there are other influencing factors."Vine." After Squirtle finished watering, Vine began to use its own grass field to help all the plants grow faster.With the help of these two Pokémon.Just three days.The first batch of vegetables planted are almost ripe.For example, the spicy banana fruit has now grown to more than one meter tall. The number of fruits hanging on it made him a little surprised.There are dozens of fruits hanging densely, and there are signs of flowering.He planted a total of thirty plants of spicy bananas, but judging from this trend, each plant could bring him dozens or even hundreds of kilograms of harvest.And things like eggplants and beans are also very pleasing to the eye.I believe that in two days, we will have a big harvest.Lin Feng was a little hopeful, using the fertilizer provided by the system and the "care" of the two Pokémon.

Take care, will the food and cooking effect made with such vegetables be improved again?"Okay, Squirtle, the first phase of your task has been completed. Starting tomorrow, you don't have to help me water the water." Squirtle, who was happily eating the energy cube, made a move, and then felt like the worker was fired, and the sky was falling in his heart.What?!Squirtle looked at Lin Feng in disbelief, his eyes suddenly filled with tears.Since the first day, it has realized the benefits of "working" with Lin Feng.Both the skill proficiency and the energy in the body are rising rapidly... Now, it just wants to work every day... "Well... it's just that the first phase of the task is over, and it's the second phase... Don't worry, the energy cubes in these few days will not break you."Lin Feng knocked it on the head, then took out a magical candy, "Here, eat it."He has also figured out the function of this magical candy in the past few days, which is to simply increase the energy intensity. Therefore, according to the efficiency of the energy growth in the Pokémon's body, taking it every three days is the best.Of course, Pokémon with better talents can shorten this time.It’s just that... this candy will probably not be as effective once the Pokémon reaches the Elite stage.Because after the elite stage, the energy intensity has reached the extreme level where it can be improved."Squirrel..." After swallowing the magical candy in one gulp, Squirtle's heart dropped. His emotions changed so drastically that he didn't even feel the energy changes in his body... "Okay, you can go back today and come back tomorrow." With something in mind, Lin Feng immediately issued an expulsion order to Squirtle."Squirtle..." After receiving the order not to be "fired", Squirtle took the energy cube and walked outside happily.Lin Feng stayed there for a while, and after the Vine Snake used the grass field to apply the "Growth" buff to all the plants, he took it to the breeding house.Plop... An elegant splash of water rose up. As soon as the ugly fish in the fish tank saw Lin Feng, it began to swim involuntarily.Obviously.As long as he sees Lin Feng, Chou Chou Yu's mood will rise inexplicably.Because of this.Lin Feng really got a lot of magical candies and golden candies from it.Of course, it is also possible that the recent ugly fish has noticed changes in itself.Because it now often faces the glass of the fish tank, the fish's eyes, which were originally dull, will appear a little more lively, as if it is using the glass to observe itself.The irregularities on its body surface were indeed smoothed out by the maintenance energy cube.
